tagline: Chemistry feels lighter with the right tools
brief: A modern, student-built chemistry toolkit unifying seven interactive calculators (Element Explorer, MoleMate, GasLab, Equation Balancer, Stoichiometry, pH Calculator, SolutionLab) into one fast, accessible web suite.
criteria: Success: immediate chemistry recognisability down to 16px, distinctive from generic textbook clip-art, scalable across dark & light surfaces, cohesive foundation for tool sub-marks.

concepts.name: Kinetic Orbitals
concepts.idea: A dense central carbon nucleus encircled by triple intersecting orbital energy shells with symmetric orbital nodes.
rationale: Direct homage to Carbon (atomic number 06, element symbol Ck), the foundational backbone of organic chemistry.
Perfect rotational symmetry at 0, 60, and 120 degrees provides instant recognition.
Engineered with a dedicated small-size cut that remains tack-sharp at 16px and 32px favicon scales.
Harmonizes naturally with the seven domain-specific tool sub-marks across the ChemKit suite.

recommendation: Kinetic Orbitals — the strongest, most timeless scientific mark. Distinctive on dark mode, clean in monochrome, and scales effortlessly from 16px tab favicon to large-format signage.
next_steps: Integrated live into ChemKit web app header, landing page, and PWA manifest
Production brand assets exported to logo/final/dist/
